name: ESP32-S3 DevKitC + PCM5102 DAC
notes: The generic route: any ESP32-S3 DevKitC-style board wired to a PCM5102/PCM5102A I2S DAC module. Wire DAC VIN->3V3, GND->GND, BCK->GPIO15, LCK->GPIO16, DIN->GPIO17. On most PCM5102 modules also tie SCK to GND (enables the internal PLL, so no master clock is needed), and check the solder-jumper defaults: FLT=GND, DEMP=GND, XSMT=3V3, FMT=GND.
